name: Payment systems
note: re-derived by `python -m foundry.completion --audit` on every CI run

refusals.grant_for_other_case: a charge needs a Consequence Gate grant issued for this exact case
refusals.live_key: only a test-mode key (sk_test_...) may be used here; live mode is a fo
refusals.metered_mismatch: metered amount 75000 does not match charge 1
refusals.no_delivery_receipt: a charge needs the delivery receipt hash it bills for
refusals.no_grant: a charge needs a Consequence Gate grant issued for this exact case
refusals.refund_without_reason: a refund needs a recorded reason
